decisions.api: New compute sampling_ops.h uses existing typed custom Operation; raw U32[R,4] key64/draw64 -> U32[R,word_count]; categorical dense half/bfloat/float[R,V]+same counters -> I32[R], optional F32[R] normalized log probability. No Operation variant growth or model policies.
decisions.counter: Philox4x32-10 exact fixed mapping; raw words cross-qualified-route exact, batch/word_count-prefix independent. Caller owns counter uniqueness/advance/overflow; prepare reads no payload.
decisions.categorical: CPU mature CDF/SIMD exp/F64 accumulation; GPU centered Gumbel+arg selection with two original words/open64 midpoint, direct smaller side and stable log1p/correction. Same native recipe replay/permutation deterministic; no CPU/GPU exact same selected-ID promise.
decisions.failure: NaN/+Inf/all-masked any row -> original checked InvalidArgument, no usable publication; -Inf excluded. CUDA validates all rows before caller output writes; original owner/accepted prefix/retirement retained on every route.
decisions.s1: CPU no Entry width scratch for count1; CUDA mature CCCL arg/segmented reduction; MLX native max/argmax plus valid tied first index; Vulkan bounded pair reduction for original row-wise dense F32 domain; other original TopK domains retained.
decisions.carrier: BORROW mature RNG equations/reduction/exponential race/CDF and Hyle SIMD/Queue/allocator/native runtime; SELF only versioned schema, fixed word addressing, necessary precision/error/completion glue. APPLICATION owns model sampling policies.
decisions.licensing: Random123 original BSD-3-Clause license, source/archive/hash and port NOTICE installed through schema dependency shared by every route; no full additional runtime. Eigen fallback used as independent mathematical reference, not new dependency.
decisions.performance: P0 categorical/raw bits, no false same-state speed peer; S1 P1 only original85bc same TopK1 both outputs/full completion/owner, R1/R16 V248320 per changed route, existing5%/n15-31 and all qualifications. Exact source timing ledger required before any benchmark construction.

diagnostic.pair_word_midpoint: U=(hi*2^32+lo+0.5)*2^-64; evaluate the smaller of U and 1-U directly from original/complemented words
diagnostic.upper_exponential: -log1p(-v), compensated logarithm fallback when native log1p absent; t==1 uses v, otherwise v*log(t)/(t-1)
diagnostic.scope: Feasibility check for CPU/CUDA/Metal/GLSL common integer inputs and stable transform; no vendor/device product executed. Does not prove categorical distribution or runtime determinism; those remain actual tests after AUDITED implementation.
